simulatedPerson.name: momentum
simulatedPerson.hiddenRule: Likes movement: implied motion, blur or diagonal compositions (80%); otherwise 20%.

interpretation.summary: Across 74 stills from 35 films, the clearest threads are momentum and hard light, in two separate strands; you were less drawn to frames within frames.

sections.title: Momentum
sections.text: The stills you liked consistently share implied motion (27 of 30 liked), and more loosely diagonal composition (14 of 15 liked). Diagonals and movement caught mid-action give a frame forward energy; the image feels like a moment taken from a continuous action. You can see it in 2001: A Space Odyssey: Frank Poole adrift in space beside the EVA pod, Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb: The B-52 banking over snow-covered mountains and Howl's Moving Castle: Howl's castle stalks across the moor under storm clouds. By contrast, you did not like Princess Mononoke: The Nightwalker (implied motion, but not diagonal composition) or The General: The locomotive on the single track through the valley (implied motion, but not diagonal composition).

claims.statement: The stills you liked consistently share implied motion (27 of 30 liked), and more loosely diagonal composition (14 of 15 liked).

sections.title: Hard light
sections.text: You tend to like stills with hard light (crisp, sharp-edged shadows from a small or distant source): 14 of 16, against 50% of the others. For example 2001: A Space Odyssey: Frank Poole adrift in space beside the EVA pod, The Bridge on the River Kwai: Colonel Nicholson under the midday sun and Double Indemnity: The office corridor.

sections.title: Two separate strands
sections.text: Your likes follow two lines that rarely meet: diagonal composition (14 liked, for example 2001: A Space Odyssey: Frank Poole adrift in space beside the EVA pod and Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb: The B-52 banking over snow-covered mountains) and hard light (14 liked, for example 2001: A Space Odyssey: Frank Poole adrift in space beside the EVA pod and The Bridge on the River Kwai: Colonel Nicholson under the midday sun). Only 3 liked stills have both, so these read as two tastes rather than one.

claims.statement: diagonal composition and hard light overlap in 3 of 25 liked stills.

sections.title: Frames within frames
sections.text: The stills you passed over consistently share foreground framing (5 of 20 liked), and more loosely frame within a frame (2 of 11 liked). Doorways, windows and foreground objects frame the subject a second time, which makes looking itself part of the image and often suggests separation or watching. For instance Double Indemnity: Keyes at his office door, Oldboy: Dae-su's beaten opponents on the floor by the open lift and Parasite: Ki-woo looks through the glass wall at the Park garden. Yet you did like Double Indemnity: The office corridor (foreground framing, but not frame within a frame) and It's a Wonderful Life: Mary in the parlour of the Hatch house (frame within a frame, but not foreground framing).

claims.statement: The stills you passed over consistently share foreground framing (5 of 20 liked), and more loosely frame within a frame (2 of 11 liked).

sections.title: How sure this is
sections.text: Some characteristics cannot yet be told apart because they occur in nearly the same stills: gaze within the frame with stillness. There are too few examples to say anything about dust (2 judged), rim light (2 judged) and extreme close-up (2 judged). All of this compares your own likes with your own dislikes among 74 stills; it is not a comparison with anyone else.
